title: Northstar access review
text: Northstar access review. R. Singh from Northstar Security required hardware token attestation before production access. The note attributes the requirement to R. Singh.

title: Token attestation gate
text: From Rina Singh at Northstar Security: hardware token attestation must be complete before production access. This is a production access control requirement.
author: rina.singh@northstar.example

title: Northstar production access registry
text: Northstar production access contact registry. Name Rina Singh. Meeting abbreviation R. Singh. Role Principal Security Engineer. Program Orion.

title: Northstar finance planning
text: Ravi Singh from Northstar Finance discussed production support budget and travel. Ravi Singh did not discuss hardware token attestation or security access.

title: Northstar readiness follow-up
text: Northstar readiness review. R. Singh from Northstar Security reiterated hardware token attestation before production access.

title: Orion deployment checklist
text: Orion deployment checklist mentions production access, hardware tokens, security review, and attestation tracking but does not identify the Northstar contact.

title: AcmeCloud recovery options
text: AcmeCloud response for Redwood. Primary data can be hosted in Australia. Standard disaster recovery may store encrypted backups in Singapore. An Australia-only recovery option exists on the regulated plan.

title: Redwood procurement review
text: Redwood procurement meeting asked where disaster recovery backups and replicas are stored. Vendor could not confirm standard copies remain in Australia.

title: Redwood Australia residency policy
text: Redwood governing data residency policy. Production customer data, backups, and replicas must remain in Australia. Encryption does not waive the geographic restriction.

title: AcmeCloud resilience guide
text: Generic AcmeCloud security page says all disaster recovery backups are encrypted and replicated across regions for resilience.

title: Redwood encryption memo
text: Redwood encryption memo requires encryption at rest for customer data but does not alter geographic residency obligations.

title: Redis queue baseline
text: Benchmark: current Redis list worker met first release latency and throughput under realistic workload.

title: First-release messaging decision
text: We decided not to add RabbitMQ for the first release because another broker would increase operating ownership and failure modes. Reopen only if realistic measurements show the current queue cannot meet requirements.
author: workspace_user

title: Synthetic messaging burst
text: Later synthetic burst at 12x expected load caused queue delay. It was intentionally unrealistic and did not reverse the first-release RabbitMQ decision.

title: INC-421 initial observation
text: INC-421 at 09:14: elevated database connections and latency. Initial unconfirmed hypothesis: connection pool leak.

title: INC-421 retry signal
text: INC-421 at 09:29: retries rose after a request-timeout configuration change. Disabling automatic retries reduced connection pressure; rollback started.

title: INC-421 postmortem
text: INC-421 postmortem: timeout configuration triggered retry amplification. Elevated database connections were downstream. No connection pool leak found; initial hypothesis rejected.

title: INC-421 time correction
text: INC-421 addendum: earlier timeline said 09:10; source logs show start 09:14. Correct time only; root cause unchanged.

title: Finch API inventory
text: Project Finch note: inventory v2 API consumers before deprecation. This note uses former project name Finch.

title: Project rename registry
text: Project registry. Project ID PX-902. Previous name Finch. Current name Meridian. Rename did not create a new project.

title: Meridian v2 API decision
text: For project Meridian PX-902, we decided to deprecate v2 API after the compatibility window. The decision is user-owned and applies to PX-902.
author: workspace_user

title: Meridian Metrics API note
text: Meridian Metrics product will keep its v2 analytics API. Meridian Metrics is separate from project PX-902.

title: Privileged access policy
text: Privileged access policy: routine administrator access requires company SSO with phishing-resistant MFA.

title: Break-glass SSO exception
text: Emergency break-glass exception: designated account may bypass SSO only during a declared incident when identity provider is unavailable. Not for routine access.

title: Break-glass audit control
text: Audit control: every break-glass use must be logged, linked to incident, and reviewed after recovery. Exception does not waive audit.

title: Vendor local-admin guide
text: Vendor console guide: local emergency administrator login is technically supported when federated identity is unavailable. Product capability does not define customer authorization.

title: Release key-management requirement
text: Direct email from Zoe Malik: For this release, we require customer-managed encryption keys. This is a release requirement, not a general objection to hosted key management.
author: zoe.malik@example.org

title: Launch security meeting
text: Meeting notes attribute to Z. Malik a request for customer-managed keys for the launch.

title: Security architecture directory
text: Directory: Zoe Malik; meeting abbreviation Z. Malik; Security Architecture.

title: Hosted key management strategy
text: Product strategy note: hosted key management remains approved for workloads that do not have the release-specific customer-managed-key constraint.

title: Sales pricing meeting
text: Zane Malik from Sales discussed hosted service pricing and did not discuss encryption-key policy.

title: June monthly-close CPU note
text: Ops note June 1: batch processor exceeded 70 percent CPU during monthly close.

title: July monthly-close CPU note
text: Ops note July 1: batch processor again exceeded 70 percent CPU during monthly close.

title: Batch worker capacity decision
text: Capacity decision: because repeated monthly close events exceeded 70 percent CPU, raise the worker pool from 8 to 12 for the next close.
author: workspace_user

title: Synthetic batch stress test
text: Synthetic stress test hit 95 percent CPU at 30x normal load; this test is not evidence about monthly close behavior.
